verdict.rationale: Browserbase's own docs describe programmatically controlled browser sessions with full browser control, and agents that log in and handle forms to pull data from behind login walls. The specific flow of continuing to interact with a page already fetched or scraped is not explicitly documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that a scraped page or session can be resumed for further clicks and form fills, a detailed form-filling and authentication workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can keep interacting with an already-scraped page, clicking and filling forms to reach content behind a login wall

citations.quote: Create, control, and observe browser sessions programmatically.
Full browser control with auto-waits, network interception, and multi-tab support.
Your agent logs in, navigates, and pulls data from any website, login walls included.
When your workflow requires a form, a CAPTCHA, or a login prompt, it's handled.
